title: Leaving Utah because of climate change
summary:
The Great Salt Lake drying up, dust storms, wildfires getting worse every summer… is anyone else starting to think about leaving Utah for good?

I moved here five years ago because it felt like an outdoor paradise. Skiing, mountain biking, fly fishing, trail running which is all within reach. For a while it genuinely was all of that.
